veranderings.rede: 'Laastens' marks the third of four steps, so the sequence eers-dan-laastens-dan reads out of order; 'daarna' keeps the order without repeating 'dan'.

veranderings.voor: Sê dan in jou eie woorde
veranderings.na: Sê laastens in jou eie woorde
veranderings.rede: Moves 'laastens' to the step that is actually last, paired with the change to the previous sentence.
